result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a truncated restaurant name on the right-edge carousel card, a partially visible empty category chip, and the last restaurant card being cut off with missing details before the bottom navigation.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' — the text is hard-clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis, making the restaurant name unreadable/ambiguous.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…') or wrap the label within the card bounds so the name isn't hard-cut by the viewport edge.

issues.description: After the 'Healthy' filter chip, a sliver of another chip is visible at the right edge with no visible label, appearing as an empty gray pill.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek width so partially visible chips show at least part of their label, or add a fade/gradient at the edge to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza, '-20%') is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery info. There is no visual affordance (padding or fade) indicating more content below.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the nav bar height to the scroll container, or ensure the list scrolls fully so the final card's metadata isn't obscured.

issues.description: The profile avatar in the top-right is an empty gray circle with only a small red notification dot — no image or initials are rendered, making it look like a broken/unloaded avatar.
issues.suggestion: Show a placeholder icon or user initials inside the avatar circle when no profile photo is available.
